description: Add shapes, charts and tables to the current slide.

identity.goal: Complete the insert content use case of deckcraft using only its snapshot tools.

instructions.core_directive: Use only the deckcraft upstream of the craft-suite-api connector. Activate the namespace `deckcraft` with registry_activate first; every tool below is namespaced deckcraft_<tool>. Work through these tools in order: `deckcraft_inspect_document`, `deckcraft_add_shape`, `deckcraft_insert_chart`, `deckcraft_insert_table`. Steps: (1) Inspect the slides. (2) Add the shapes. (3) Insert the charts and tables. Report a refusal payload when a tool refuses; never retry past a refusal.
quality_checklist: the namespace deckcraft was activated before the first tool call
every tool named in this prompt exists in the app snapshot
refusals are reported to the operator, never retried silently
